agentDesc: Lingo: a custom button-activated Korean translator for English, Simplified Chinese and French. Say open Lingo to launch.
agentPrompt: Launch this custom app when the user explicitly asks open Lingo, Lingo, or 링고. Open the full-screen pages/index/index page. Do not claim generic translate or translation requests intended for the built-in translator. All controls are Korean and input is fixed to ko-KR. The user selects the target language with buttons and starts each recording explicitly. Prepare a translation session during recording, then show streamed translation from the final recognized text. French offers optional approximate Hangul reading. Use the page, not a chat answer. Back closes this app; one minute of inactivity only clears its display.
